id: 16_Fire Safety Accident Investigation Job Safety Analysis MCQs Test Test Your Safet
title: 五合一安全五十问（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/16_Fire Safety Accident Investigation Job Safety Analysis MCQs Test Test Your Safet.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/16_Fire Safety Accident Investigation Job Safety Analysis MCQs Test Test Your Safet（国内版）/src.py

points.K14: 二氧化碳灭火器灭哪类火
points.K21: 调查为查事实不为追责
points.K26: 警戒带是保护不是记录
points.S2: 不安全行为背后：防错设计
points.S3: 久站实验台：换姿与防疲劳

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一叠题卡，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a stack of blank question cards and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 五套题、五十问，一口气复习完。

shots.scene: 五个图标：火焰、灭火器、放大镜、台阶、齿轮
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a flame, a fire extinguisher, a magnifying glass, a staircase and a gear. No people.
shots.narration: 消防、灭火器、事故调查、危害分析、机械。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着电脑上的安全考试界面发愁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at a blank online exam screen on a laptop.
shots.narration: 阿杰要参加实验室安全考试，心里没底。

shots.scene: 小研拿着题卡坐到他旁边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits down next to him with a stack of blank question cards.
shots.narration: 小研说：我陪你过一遍，每题讲个为什么。

shots.scene: 木头、塑料盒、纸张燃烧的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of burning wood, a plastic box and paper. No people.
shots.narration: 第一部分消防：木头塑料纸张属哪类火？

shots.scene: A类火图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A solid-fire class pictogram glows. No people.
shots.narration: A类火，就是普通固体物质着火。

shots.scene: 砂轮、切割、焊接三个火花图标
shots.prompt_en: Three spark icons: grinding, cutting and welding. No people.
shots.narration: 磨削、切割、焊接，都算动火。

shots.scene: 火花溅到纸箱上
shots.prompt_en: Sparks land on a cardboard box nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 都会产生火花，周围可燃物要清走。

shots.scene: 灭火器上浮现四个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons float beside a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 用灭火器的口诀是PASS。

shots.scene: 相似的字母卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: Look-alike letter cards are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 别被长得像的口诀骗了。

shots.scene: 小研持灭火器，背后是出口门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds an extinguisher with the exit door behind her.
shots.narration: 灭火时站哪儿？背对出口。

shots.scene: 火势变大，小研转身从出口撤离
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows and the female graduate student turns and leaves through the exit behind her.
shots.narration: 灭不了，转身就能撤。

shots.scene: 火场里一个人被困，旁边有设备
shots.prompt_en: A person trapped near a fire beside some lab equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 着火了先救谁？

shots.scene: 人形图标被引导离开
shots.prompt_en: A person icon is guided away from the fire. No people.
shots.narration: 先救正处在危险中的人。

shots.scene: 小研和火之间有一段距离
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at a safe distance from a small fire, aiming an extinguisher.
shots.narration: 灭火要和火保持安全距离。

shots.scene: 灭火器标签特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a blank extinguisher label with a distance icon. No people.
shots.narration: 距离按灭火器说明和火势定。

shots.scene: 三角形三边：热、氧气、可燃物
shots.prompt_en: A triangle with a flame icon on one side, an oxygen icon on another and a log on the third. No people.
shots.narration: 火三角：热、氧气、可燃物。

shots.scene: 拿掉氧气一边，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The oxygen side of the triangle is removed and the flame goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 少了任何一样，火就烧不起来。

shots.scene: 传导、辐射、对流三个箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: Three heat transfer icons: a hot rod, radiating waves and rising hot air. No people.
shots.narration: 热靠传导、辐射、对流传递。

shots.scene: 喷头里的易熔元件受热熔断
shots.prompt_en: A fusible element inside a sprinkler head melts from heat. No people.
shots.narration: 易熔元件是受热触发的部件，不是传热方式。

shots.scene: 警报响起，阿杰还想把实验做完
shots.prompt_en: An alarm rings while the young male student keeps working on his experiment.
shots.narration: 紧急情况，什么最不重要？

shots.scene: 小研拉他撤离
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls the young male student toward the exit.
shots.narration: 完成实验！记住程序、引导员和集合点。

shots.scene: 三种灭火方法图标：移走燃料、盖住、浇水
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: removing fuel, covering with a lid and cooling with water. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火三法：隔离、窒息、冷却。

shots.scene: 盖子盖住烧杯里的小火
shots.prompt_en: A lid is placed over a small fire in a beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室小火，盖住隔绝空气也有效。

shots.scene: 阿杰按下报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses a fire alarm call point on the wall.
shots.narration: 第二部分：发现火情先做什么？

shots.scene: 电话图标119
shots.prompt_en: A large telephone icon with a flame symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 按报警、打119，不要一声不吭跑掉。

shots.scene: 拔销、瞄准、压把、扫射四格图
shots.prompt_en: Four panels: pulling a pin, aiming a hose, squeezing a handle and sweeping side to side. No people.
shots.narration: PASS：拔销、对准、压把、扫射。

shots.scene: 小研左右扫射
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sweeps the extinguisher nozzle from side to side at the base of a small fire.
shots.narration: 压住把手，从近到远左右扫。

shots.scene: 喷嘴对准火焰根部
shots.prompt_en: An extinguisher nozzle aimed at the base of the flames. No people.
shots.narration: 喷嘴对哪？对准火焰根部。

shots.scene: 对着火焰顶部喷的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of spraying at the top of flames, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 喷火苗顶部，灭不了火源。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器灭哪类火
shots.scene: 二氧化碳灭火器旁，液体火和带电设备图标
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide extinguisher beside icons of a burning liquid and live electrical equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳灭火器：灭液体火和带电火。
overlay: 二氧化碳灭火器灭哪类火

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器灭哪类火
shots.scene: 一本书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 国内分类不同，以国家标准为准。

shots.scene: 出口在小研身后
shots.prompt_en: The exit door stays behind the female graduate student as she faces the fire.
shots.narration: 始终让出口在身后：正确。

shots.scene: 小研后退几步到出口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steps back toward the exit door behind her.
shots.narration: 火控制不住，随时能退出去。

shots.scene: 火三角再次出现
shots.prompt_en: The fire triangle appears again. No people.
shots.narration: 三要素：氧气、可燃物、热源。

shots.scene: 拿掉一边，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: One side of the triangle is removed and the flame goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 拿掉任何一样，火就灭。

shots.scene: 木头、纸、布的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of wood, paper and cloth. No people.
shots.narration: A类火是普通可燃物着火。

shots.scene: 木头和纸着火，水型灭火器打勾
shots.prompt_en: Burning wood and paper with a water extinguisher and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 这类火可以用水型或干粉扑救。

shots.scene: 干粉灭火器旁三类火图标
shots.prompt_en: A dry powder extinguisher beside three fire class icons: solid, liquid and gas. No people.
shots.narration: ABC干粉，能灭三类火。

shots.scene: 带电设备图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A live electrical equipment icon with a green check beside the powder extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 也能扑救带电设备初起火灾。

shots.scene: 水型灭火器喷水，温度计下降
shots.prompt_en: A water extinguisher sprays and a thermometer icon drops. No people.
shots.narration: 水型灭火器靠冷却灭火。

shots.scene: 水浇到油火和带电设备的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of water on an oil fire and on live equipment, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 油火、带电火不能用水。

shots.scene: 实验楼走廊里的干粉灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A dry powder extinguisher mounted in a laboratory building corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的灭火器是干粉。

shots.scene: 小研指着走廊里的灭火器位置
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points out where the extinguisher hangs in the corridor.
shots.narration: 平时就要记住它放在哪。

shots.section_title: 调查为查事实不为追责
shots.scene: 放大镜看现场，法槌卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier over an incident scene, beside a judge gavel card crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 第三部分：调查事故为了什么？
overlay: 调查为查事实不为追责

shots.section_title: 调查为查事实不为追责
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger.
shots.narration: 查事实，不为找人追责。

shots.scene: 王老师和阿杰面对面谈话
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator talks calmly with the young male student at a table.
shots.narration: 访谈为了什么？还原真实经过。

shots.scene: 阿杰放松地讲述
shots.prompt_en: The young male student explains with relaxed gestures.
shots.narration: 不指责，大家才愿意说实话。

shots.scene: 报告只写个人失误，系统齿轮缺失
shots.prompt_en: A report with a single person icon and a missing system gear. No people.
shots.narration: 报告没用，常因没提系统改进。

shots.scene: 报告里加上齿轮图标
shots.prompt_en: A system gear icon is added to the report. No people.
shots.narration: 只怪个人，同样的事还会再发生。

shots.scene: 工作受限、停工、死亡三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a restricted arm, a calendar with lost days and a black ribbon. No people.
shots.narration: 受限、停工、死亡的伤病都要记录。

shots.scene: 空白伤病记录本
shots.prompt_en: A blank injury record book. No people.
shots.narration: 国内按工伤和事故报告规定执行。

shots.scene: 短期修补和长期改进两张卡片
shots.prompt_en: Two cards: a quick fix bandage icon and a long-term system gear icon. No people.
shots.narration: 建议要有短期纠正和长期改进。

shots.scene: 创可贴和齿轮两张卡片都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Both the bandage card and the gear card get green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 先止住眼前风险，再改制度流程。

shots.section_title: 警戒带是保护不是记录
shots.scene: 拍照、观察、书面陈述打勾，警戒带单独放
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a camera, an eye and a written statement with checks, and barrier tape set apart. No people.
shots.narration: 拍照、观察、陈述是记录现场。
overlay: 警戒带是保护不是记录

shots.section_title: 警戒带是保护不是记录
shots.scene: 警戒带围住现场
shots.prompt_en: Barrier tape surrounds an incident scene. No people.
shots.narration: 拉警戒带是保护现场。

shots.scene: 现场还在冒烟，王老师等候
shots.prompt_en: Smoke still rises from a scene while the safety administrator waits outside the tape.
shots.narration: 什么时候开始调查？确认安全以后。

shots.scene: 烟散去后王老师进入现场
shots.prompt_en: After the smoke clears, the safety administrator enters the scene with a notebook.
shots.narration: 调查的人不能成为新的伤者。

shots.scene: 整体被拆成几块拼图
shots.prompt_en: A whole shape separates into puzzle pieces for study. No people.
shots.narration: 分析，就是把整体拆开来研究。

shots.scene: 拼图块分别被放大镜查看
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier examines each puzzle piece separately. No people.
shots.narration: 一块块看清，再找出关联。

shots.scene: 人的图标后面露出管理体系的齿轮
shots.prompt_en: Behind a person icon, gears of a management system appear. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答多数事故源于不安全行为。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wags a finger gently.
shots.narration: 还要追问：管理上哪里出了缺口。

shots.scene: 树根图标深入地下
shots.prompt_en: A tree icon with deep roots highlighted underground. No people.
shots.narration: 找系统缺陷，靠根本原因分析。

shots.scene: 树根上浮现管理、培训、设备三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a management chart, a training book and a machine appear on the tree roots. No people.
shots.narration: 追到管理、培训、设备上的缺陷。

shots.scene: 实验台四周四个图标
shots.prompt_en: A lab bench surrounded by a map pin, a person, a spark and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 第四部分：描述危害讲哪四点？

shots.scene: 四个图标合成圆
shots.prompt_en: The four icons join into a circle with a check. No people.
shots.narration: 在哪、伤谁、怎么引发、什么后果。

shots.scene: 盾牌卡片打勾，法槌打叉
shots.prompt_en: A shield card with a check and a gavel card crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 做危害分析，为的是消除和预防。

shots.scene: 事故图标被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: An accident icon is blocked by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 不是为了处分，更不是找活干。

shots.scene: 记录本里绷带和差点滑倒图标
shots.prompt_en: A record book with a bandage icon and a near-slip icon. No people.
shots.narration: 先翻事故和未遂记录：正确。

shots.scene: 平面图上出过事的位置闪红
shots.prompt_en: A lab floor plan with a spot flashing red. No people.
shots.narration: 出过事的地方，往往还藏着危害。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔五层
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid of five colored layers. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制最有效？原题答正确。

shots.scene: 顶层两层亮起
shots.prompt_en: The top two layers of the pyramid glow. No people.
shots.narration: 其实消除、替代更优，工程排第三。

shots.scene: 任务切成方块，放大镜、盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A task cut into blocks, with a magnifier and shields beside each. No people.
shots.narration: 拆步骤、找危害、定措施。

shots.scene: 三栏分析表贴在实验台旁
shots.prompt_en: A blank three-column analysis sheet pinned beside a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 步骤、危害、措施三栏对应。

shots.scene: 阿杰弯腰扭身搬试剂箱，腰部红点
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends and twists to lift a reagent box; his lower back glows red.
shots.narration: 弯腰搬重物：伸手扭身伤下背。

shots.scene: 改用推车
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts the box on a trolley instead.
shots.narration: 能用推车，就别弯腰硬搬。

shots.scene: 阿杰演示操作，老周记录
shots.prompt_en: The young male student demonstrates a task while the older man takes notes.
shots.narration: 只让负责人做？错，要员工参与。

shots.scene: 灯泡在阿杰头顶亮起
shots.prompt_en: A light bulb appears above the young male student's head.
shots.narration: 天天动手的人，最清楚哪里危险。

shots.scene: 三格填空：放大镜、切块、看懂警示
shots.prompt_en: Three boxes filled with a magnifier, a cut block and people looking at a warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 辨识危害、分解作业、帮人看懂危害。

shots.scene: 一群人看着警示牌点头
shots.prompt_en: A group of person icons look at a warning sign and nod. No people.
shots.narration: 让每个人都看懂身边的危害。

shots.scene: 围桌讨论的四人
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student, the young male student and the safety administrator discuss at a table.
shots.narration: 一个人做更好？错，要团队一起。

shots.scene: 问号变成勾
shots.prompt_en: Question marks above the table turn into check marks.
shots.narration: 多双眼睛，漏掉的危害更少。

shots.scene: 带绷带的作业卡排第一
shots.prompt_en: A task card with a bandage icon moves to the front of the line. No people.
shots.narration: 出过伤害的作业优先分析：正确。

shots.scene: 差点出事的卡片排第二
shots.prompt_en: A card with an exclamation icon moves to second place. No people.
shots.narration: 差点出事、后果严重的紧随其后。

shots.scene: 挤压、卷入、飞出物三图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: squeezed fingers, meshing gears and a flying fragment. No people.
shots.narration: 第五部分：运动部件伤人有三种。

shots.scene: 离心机和真空泵皮带
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge and a vacuum pump belt in a lab. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室的离心机、泵皮带也一样。

shots.scene: 老李讲解防护罩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer explains a protective cover to students.
shots.narration: 培训：怎么用、何时拆、谁能拆。

shots.scene: 钥匙只交给持证人员
shots.prompt_en: A key is handed only to a person with a badge. No people.
shots.narration: 不是谁都能随手拆防护罩。

shots.scene: 警示带卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: A barrier tape card crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 警示带只是提醒，不是防护装置。

shots.scene: 手从警示带下伸向皮带的图标
shots.prompt_en: A hand reaching under barrier tape toward a moving belt. No people.
shots.narration: 它挡不住伸进去的手。

shots.scene: 开关上锁挂牌
shots.prompt_en: A switch locked with a padlock and a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 拆罩维修前，先上锁挂牌。

shots.scene: 老李按开关确认不启动
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses a start button to confirm nothing starts.
shots.narration: 试一下，确认真的断开。

shots.scene: 固定式、联锁式、可调式、自调式四图标
shots.prompt_en: Four guard icons: a bolted cover, an interlocked door, an adjustable cover and a self-adjusting cover. No people.
shots.narration: 防护装置常见四类。

shots.scene: 联锁门一开机器停
shots.prompt_en: An interlocked door opens and the machine stops. No people.
shots.narration: 比如联锁式：门一开，机器就停。

shots.scene: 牢固的防护罩完全罩住部件
shots.prompt_en: A sturdy guard fully encloses moving parts and is bolted to the frame. No people.
shots.narration: 要结实、固定牢、全罩住。

shots.scene: 罩子用螺栓固定在机身
shots.prompt_en: A guard bolted firmly to the machine frame. No people.
shots.narration: 松垮、留缺口的罩子，等于没有。

shots.scene: 锋利罩边划手的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sharp guard edge cutting a hand, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 防护不能带来新危害。

shots.scene: 大开口和易碎罩卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: Cards of a guard with a big opening and a cracked guard, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 也不能留大口子、一碰就碎。

shots.scene: 人和齿轮间的透明墙
shots.prompt_en: A clear wall between a person icon and rotating gears. No people.
shots.narration: 给运动部件设屏障的，是防护装置。

shots.scene: 制度书打叉，防护罩打勾
shots.prompt_en: A rule book crossed out and a guard with a check. No people.
shots.narration: 不是制度规定，是实实在在的屏障。

shots.scene: 缺了防护罩的机器亮红
shots.prompt_en: A machine with a missing guard glows red. No people.
shots.narration: 机械事故主因：防护缺失或损坏。

shots.scene: 检查表图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank inspection checklist icon. No people.
shots.narration: 缺检查维护，防护也会失效。

shots.scene: 屏障把人和危险隔开，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A barrier separates a person icon from moving parts, with a check. No people.
shots.narration: 防护的目的：隔开人和危险。

shots.scene: 防止机器损坏的卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: A card about preventing machine breakdown, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不是为了保护机器不坏。

shots.scene: 阿杰的袖子着火，惊慌要跑，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person with a burning sleeve running in panic, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 衣服着火，千万别跑。

shots.scene: 停下、躺倒、捂脸翻滚三格图
shots.prompt_en: Three panels: a person stopping, dropping to the floor and rolling while covering the face. No people.
shots.narration: 停下、躺倒、捂脸来回滚。

shots.scene: 紧急喷淋装置，小研拉下拉手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls the handle of an emergency safety shower.
shots.narration: 实验室有紧急喷淋，就近冲淋。

shots.scene: 旁人用灭火毯裹住火的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a helper wrapping a fire blanket around a person's burning sleeve. No people.
shots.narration: 旁人用灭火毯帮忙压灭，再送医。

shots.section_title: 不安全行为背后：防错设计
shots.scene: 阿杰拿错了两个长得一样的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up one of two identical-looking reagent bottles, confused.
shots.narration: 看似不安全行为，常有环境诱因。
overlay: 不安全行为背后：防错设计

shots.section_title: 不安全行为背后：防错设计
shots.scene: 两瓶贴上不同颜色标签、分开放
shots.prompt_en: The two bottles get different colored labels and are stored apart. No people.
shots.narration: 标签醒目、分开存放，减少拿错。

shots.section_title: 不安全行为背后：防错设计
shots.scene: 设备开关加防误触罩
shots.prompt_en: A guard cover is added over an equipment switch to prevent accidental pressing. No people.
shots.narration: 开关加防误触，流程加核对。

shots.section_title: 久站实验台：换姿与防疲劳
shots.scene: 小研在通风柜前站了很久，腿部和腰部红点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at a fume hood for a long time; red glows on her legs and lower back.
shots.narration: 久站实验台，腿酸腰痛。
overlay: 久站实验台：换姿与防疲劳

shots.section_title: 久站实验台：换姿与防疲劳
shots.scene: 脚下铺防疲劳垫，一只脚踩在搁脚台上
shots.prompt_en: An anti-fatigue mat under her feet and one foot resting on a low footrest.
shots.narration: 铺防疲劳垫，脚下放个搁脚台。

shots.section_title: 久站实验台：换姿与防疲劳
shots.scene: 能坐的步骤改用高脚椅
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits on a tall lab stool for a seated step.
shots.narration: 能坐着做的步骤，就用高脚椅。

shots.section_title: 久站实验台：换姿与防疲劳
shots.scene: 小研活动小腿和腰
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stretches her calves and back during a pause.
shots.narration: 穿舒适的鞋，定时活动换姿。

shots.scene: 整改清单上逐项打勾，旁边日历
shots.prompt_en: A blank corrective action list with checks and a calendar beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 提了整改，还要定人定时间。

shots.scene: 王老师回到现场检查整改效果
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator returns to the lab to check a completed corrective action.
shots.narration: 到期回头查，看措施真起作用了没。

shots.scene: 经验分享会上大家听讲
shots.prompt_en: Students listen at a short safety sharing meeting led by the older man.
shots.narration: 把教训讲给大家听，防止再犯。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard with five icons: a flame, an extinguisher, a magnifier, steps and a gear.
shots.narration: 五套题，记住几个关键。

shots.scene: PASS四格和出口箭头
shots.prompt_en: PASS panels and an exit arrow behind a person. No people.
shots.narration: 先报警，PASS对根部，出口在身后。

shots.scene: 放大镜和树根
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier and a tree root icon. No people.
shots.narration: 调查查事实，追到根本原因。

shots.scene: 台阶、盾牌、锁
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a staircase, a shield and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 危害分析大家做，拆罩先上锁。

shots.scene: 停躺滚和防疲劳垫
shots.prompt_en: Icons of stop-drop-roll and an anti-fatigue mat. No people.
shots.narration: 着火停躺滚，久站勤换姿。

shots.scene: 阿杰举着通过的考试卡，欣欣挥手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up a blank exam pass card while the panda mascot waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 知其然，更知其所以然！
